name: unfollowers-for-instagram
description: See which accounts you follow don't follow you back, plus your fans and new unfollowers. Bulk unfollow with safe pacing. 100% private and client-side. Not affiliated with Instagram or Meta.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --loader:.svg=text --loader:.css=text --minify --outfile=dist/index.min.js && node scripts/update-html.js
scripts.package:extension: npm run build && node scripts/create-extension-icons.js && npm run package:source && (cd extension && zip -q -r ../extension.zip . -x extension.zip)
